Pocket Vault — локальное хранилище парол: Pocket Vault is a local vault for passwords and other short secrets inside a Telegram Mini App.
Пользователь может сохранять названия, п: You may save titles, passwords, keys, PINs, and descriptions. Every entry field is encrypted on the device before storage.
Зашифрованный контейнер хранится локальн: The encrypted container is stored locally through Telegram DeviceStorage. The master password is not written to DeviceStorage, SecureStorage, or localStorage. Pocket Vault has no server, accounts, or cloud sync.
Выбранные язык, тема интерфейса и время: The selected language, interface theme, and auto-lock time are stored separately in browser localStorage and contain no vault data.
Мастер-пароль не отправляется разработчи: The master password is never sent to the developer and is not stored after entry. The unlocked session exists only in WebView memory and locks after the selected inactivity period, on manual lock, or when the WebView is unloaded. Without the master password, entries cannot be decrypted; if it is lost, you can only destroy the local vault and start over.
Пользователь может уничтожить хранилище: You may destroy the vault without the master password after explicit confirmation. The app removes values belonging to Pocket Vault. This does not guarantee physical erasure of backups that may have been created by the operating system or Telegram.
При нажатии «Скопировать» выбранный секр: When you select Copy, the chosen secret is placed on the system clipboard. Further storage and access are controlled by your device and operating system.
В приложении нет аналитики, рекламных тр: The app contains no analytics, advertising trackers, or first-party cookies. The hosting provider and Telegram may process standard request metadata under their own policies, but vault contents are not included in those requests.
Хранилище привязано к конкретному Telegr: The vault is tied to a specific Telegram client and device. Removing the app, clearing Telegram data, or resetting the device may permanently erase entries. Anyone who obtains a copy of the ciphertext can attempt offline password guessing, so use a long, unique phrase.
